description: Short, natural email examples for evaluating Laya.

expected_actionability.YES: A task or decision is required.

emails.subject: Website is down
emails.body: The website is down and customers cannot use it. Please fix it now.
emails.rationale: Customers cannot use the website and immediate action is requested.

emails.subject: Someone accessed our account
emails.body: Someone accessed our company account without permission. Please investigate and secure it immediately.
emails.rationale: Unauthorized access requires immediate security action.

emails.subject: Payment due tomorrow
emails.body: Please pay this invoice by tomorrow and confirm once it is done.
emails.rationale: A clear payment request has a near-term deadline.

emails.subject: Send the client report
emails.body: Please finish the client report and send it by Friday.
emails.expected_action: Finish and send the client report
emails.rationale: An important deliverable has a clear deadline.

emails.subject: Review this document
emails.body: Please review this document when you have time.
emails.rationale: A routine task has no stated deadline.

emails.subject: Send the meeting notes
emails.body: Please send today's meeting notes to the team.
emails.rationale: A simple follow-up task is requested.

emails.subject: Weekly company news
emails.body: Here are this week's company news and product updates. Enjoy reading!
emails.rationale: The email only shares information.

emails.subject: Special discount this week
emails.body: Get 20% off our premium plan this week. Visit our website if you are interested.
emails.rationale: The email is a promotion, not a required task.

emails.subject: Your password reset request
emails.body: We received a request to reset your password. If you did not request this, you do not need to do anything.
emails.rationale: The message does not require action in the stated scenario.

emails.subject: Join our webinar
emails.body: We are hosting a webinar next week. Join us if you are interested.
emails.rationale: Attendance is optional.

emails.subject: Can we finish this soon?
emails.body: Let's finish this soon. Let me know what you think.
emails.rationale: The requested action and deadline are unclear.

emails.subject: Urgent company announcement
emails.body: Urgent announcement: our office will be closed next Monday. No action is required.
emails.rationale: Urgent wording does not create a task when no action is required.

emails.subject: Update the project documentation
emails.body: Please update the project documentation with the latest changes. There is no fixed deadline.
emails.rationale: A routine task is requested without a deadline.

emails.subject: Invoice payment is overdue
emails.body: This invoice is overdue. Please contact the accounts team and ask when payment will be made.
emails.rationale: The overdue invoice needs follow-up, but no critical impact is stated.

emails.subject: Backup failed last night
emails.body: Last night's backup failed. Please check the error and make sure the next backup works.
emails.rationale: An operational issue needs attention, but no immediate disaster is established.

emails.subject: Tell us what you think
emails.body: Please complete our survey if you have time. Taking part is optional.
emails.rationale: The survey is explicitly optional.

emails.subject: Meeting moved to 3 PM
emails.body: Today's meeting has moved from 2 PM to 3 PM. The calendar invitation has been updated.
emails.rationale: The email provides a schedule update without requesting an action.

emails.subject: Your account access expires soon
emails.body: Your project account access expires in three days. Please renew it if you still need access.
emails.rationale: Access expires soon and renewal may be necessary.

emails.subject: New training course available
emails.body: A new training course is available. Take a look if you are interested.
emails.rationale: The course is optional and no action is required.

emails.subject: The settings page is not saving
emails.body: The settings page is not saving changes. Please check the problem and let me know what you find.
emails.rationale: A concrete bug investigation is requested, without evidence of a critical incident.
